checkedAlternates.risk: Cap height is near the top of letters like ascenders.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Cap height is a horizontal metric line (group-1), whereas ascender, apex, and tittle are physical glyph parts (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: A bowl can appear on letters like b or P.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A bowl is the curved stroke enclosing an interior counter space (group-4).
